Magistrate '''Caitlyn Modera''' is a [[human]] located at the [[Jousting Grounds]] in [[Northwind]]. She is the daughter of [[Archmage Modera]], a member of the [[Council of Six]].

==Quotes==
;Gossip
Have you seen that silver fox from [[Stromgarde (kingdom)|Stromgarde]] over there? Isn't he just stunning?

<Modera's eyes are sparkling at the sight of [[Commander Leder]]. Being obviously enchanted by his appearance, she loses her train of thought before quickly regaining composure.>

Oh, excuse me. How rude. I am Caitlyn Modera, daughter of Archmage Modera of the [[Council of Six]] governing Dalaran. My mother is incredibly busy rebuilding our great city, as you may have heard already, so I am here in her stead representing Dalaran.
